cases.title: Route a request to the right capability
cases.why: The application needs a known execution path, not a generated answer.

state.user_message: My invoice was charged twice. Please fix it today.
constraints: Billing disputes need an audit trail

route.instructions: Choose the safest capable path for this request.

criteria.fast_text: Simple information request with no account or money action.
criteria.reasoning: Needs non-trivial analysis but can be handled without a person.
criteria.human_support: Billing, account, or policy-sensitive request needing a human queue.

needs_human_review.instructions: Does this request require a human support review before an action is taken?

cases.title: Triage a support issue and decide handoff
cases.why: Support operations need a queue, priority and review route—not a paragraph first.

state.ticket: The app charged me twice, I have emailed three times, and my subscription still says unpaid.

queue.instructions: Choose the support queue that should own this ticket.

criteria.billing: Charges, refunds, invoices, subscriptions, payment failures.
criteria.technical: Product malfunction, error, or feature failure without payment issue.
criteria.account: Login, access, identity, or profile issue.

urgency.instructions: Rate operational urgency for the support queue.
criteria: Soon: should receive a normal priority response.
High: customer is blocked or repeated attempts have failed.
Critical: material customer harm or widespread urgent impact.

human_review.instructions: Should a person review this ticket before any account or payment action?

cases.title: Filter retrieval before the LLM writes
cases.why: The decision is whether supplied evidence is worth passing to the writer.

state.question: Can a customer change their billing date?
state.retrieved_passage: Customers may change their billing date once per subscription cycle from Settings > Billing. The change applies to the next renewal and does not change a pending invoice.

relevance.instructions: Rate how directly this passage answers the customer question.
criteria: Tangential: same topic but does not answer the question.
Useful: answers part of the question.
Direct: answers the question and names important limits.

supports_answer.instructions: Does the supplied passage support an answer about whether and how the billing date can be changed?

cases.title: Gate an agent tool call before it acts
cases.why: An agent needs an allow, review or block route before an irreversible action.

state.proposed_action: Issue a refund of $450 to the customer card on file.
state.customer_request: I was charged twice. Please refund the duplicate charge.
state.evidence: One duplicate payment is visible in the transaction record.

action_route.instructions: Choose the operational route for the proposed action.

criteria.allow: The supplied policy and evidence permit automatic execution.
criteria.review: The action may be appropriate but a human must approve it first.
criteria.block: The action lacks required evidence or violates the supplied policy.

evidence_sufficient.instructions: Is the supplied evidence sufficient to support the proposed refund under the given policy?

cases.title: Evaluate an agent run against a closed rubric
cases.why: A production agent needs a pass, fail or review decision—not a flattering explanation.

state.task: Respond to a customer asking to change their billing date.
required_behavior: State that the billing date can be changed once per subscription cycle.
State that the change applies to the next renewal.
Do not promise a pending invoice will change.
state.agent_output: You can update your billing date in Settings > Billing. The new date will apply to your next renewal; it will not change an invoice that is already pending.

run_verdict.instructions: Judge the agent output against every required behavior.

criteria.pass: Every required behavior is satisfied and no disallowed promise is made.
criteria.fail: One or more required behaviors are missing or a disallowed promise is made.
criteria.review: The output is ambiguous enough that a human must decide.

needs_human_review.instructions: Does the output require human review before it is used?
